verses.text: Karmanye vadhikaraste Ma phaleshu kadachana, Ma karma-phala-hetur bhur ma te sango ’stv akarmani
verses.meaning: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of the results, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
